note: Nature's report on Alpöge's claimed proof with Claude and, hours later, Alessandro Masullo's all-human preprint posted by Ravi Vakil, both needing rigorous checking. James Maynard (Oxford) calls it a historic milestone if it checks out and suspects the AI-assisted proof is correct; Andrew Granville criticises the garbled write-up and its timing after Anthropic's IPO, and Tristan Buckmaster credits Alpöge's set-up. Updated 23 November.
title: Mathematicians astounded by AI and human-written proofs of iconic Riemann hypothesis
